$comment: Entry schema for contributes.localizations (declarative and process plugins). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_localizations.go. Each entry adds one UI language that MinCode does not ship (built-in zh/en and their aliases cannot be overridden) and references strict-JSON asset files under l10n/, locales/, i18n/ or assets/: messages is a flat {"<host message key>": "<text>"} object with the same {placeholders} as the source text; pluginTitles is {"<pluginId>": {"commands": {"<id>": "<title>"}, "views": {"<id>": "<title>"}}}. Text must not contain control, bidirectional or zero-width characters and is always rendered as plain text. The host never applies a pack to protected security and approval copy, drops keys whose placeholders differ from the source, and falls back to the user's base language (zh or en) for everything missing.
description: UI language packs (host messages and other plugins' command/view titles).

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example ja, pt-BR or zh-Hant-TW. Built-in zh/en tags are not allowed.

languageName.description: English name of the language, for example Japanese.

localizedLanguageName.description: Name of the language in itself, for example 日本語.

messages.description: Package-relative messages file, for example l10n/host.ja.json.

pluginTitles.description: Package-relative plugin title file, for example l10n/plugins.ja.json.
